powers.name: Accelerated Healing
powers.effect: Any healing or regeneration received is doubled; also regenerates 1 1st Deg wound per round.
powers.notes:
Accelerated Healing is an advanced ability that empowers the Horax Bio Engineer to significantly enhance the regenerative capabilities of an ally. By accelerating the body's natural healing processes, this ability ensures that the ally can recover from injuries much faster, maintaining their combat effectiveness even in prolonged battles. The Bio Engineer's intervention allows the hive’s warriors to endure and thrive, even under intense pressure.

When Accelerated Healing is activated, the target's wounds begin to heal at an accelerated rate, visibly knitting together before the eyes of onlookers. A soft, greenish glow suffuses the injured areas, with tiny, sparkling motes of bio-energy swirling around the wounds, mending tissue and restoring vitality with every passing second. The sensation is warm and soothing, as if a gentle wave of energy is washing over the target, steadily erasing the pain and fatigue that once threatened to overwhelm them. The aura of rapid regeneration not only provides physical restoration but also a psychological boost, as the target feels their strength returning with each heartbeat.

With Accelerated Healing, the Horax Bio Engineer ensures that the hive’s warriors remain resilient and capable, able to recover quickly from the rigors of battle and continue fighting with renewed strength.

powers.name: Adaptive Camouflage
powers.effect: If perfectly still: undetectable vs full-spectrum vision. If moving: [Camo Stealth(🏃)] at MR1-3, [Camo Stealth(🏃-1)] at MR5-6, [Camo Stealth(🏃-1)] at MR7-9; fails at MR 10+.
powers.notes:
Adaptive Camouflage is an advanced ability that allows the Starborn Ranger to blend seamlessly into any environment, rendering them nearly invisible to the naked eye. This ability is crucial for stealth operations, enabling the Ranger to move undetected through hostile territory and execute ambushes with lethal precision.

When Adaptive Camouflage is activated, the Ranger's suit and exposed skin shift in color and texture to match their surroundings perfectly. As the Ranger moves, their appearance subtly changes to blend with the environment, creating a chameleon-like effect that makes them difficult to detect. In the stillness of the jungle or the urban sprawl, the Ranger becomes a ghost, their outline dissolving into the background as they prepare to strike from the shadows.

Adaptive Camouflage turns the Ranger into an unseen predator, a master of stealth capable of moving through enemy lines undetected and striking with deadly precision.

powers.name: Aether Burst
powers.effect: Melee weapon's Wnds+2
powers.notes:
Aether Burst is a devastating ability that channels the raw power of the Nyax Aetherblade’s Aether Sword, unleashing a concentrated surge of Aetheric energy upon impact. This ability significantly amplifies the damage dealt by the sword, making each strike potentially fatal and leaving a lasting impression on the battlefield.

When Aether Burst is activated, the Aether Sword glows with an intense, otherworldly light, the runes along its blade flaring to life with Aetheric energy. As the Aetherblade strikes, the sword releases a powerful burst of energy that doubles the severity of the inflicted wounds, causing the enemy to stagger under the force of the blow. The impact is accompanied by a shockwave of light and sound, marking the devastating power of the Aether Burst and ensuring that the strike leaves no doubt of the Aetherblade’s lethal intent.

Aether Burst transforms the Aether Sword into a weapon of unrivaled destruction, capable of cutting down even the most resilient foes with a single, overpowering strike.

powers.name: Aether Clone
powers.effect: Clone is totally real and can do anything the caster can (powers, weapons, etc.); clone vanishes upon receiving wounds.
powers.notes:
Aether Clone allows the Nyax Aetherblade to summon a temporary duplicate of themselves, formed entirely from Aether energy. This clone is a perfect replica, sharing the same thoughts, motivations, and combat abilities as the original, fighting alongside them to confuse and overwhelm enemies.

As the Aetherblade channels their energy, a shimmering silhouette begins to form beside them. The outline of the Aether Clone solidifies, taking on the exact appearance of the Aetherblade, right down to the smallest detail. The clone’s eyes glow with a soft, otherworldly light, its movements perfectly synchronized with the Aetherblade’s, as if they are one being. To onlookers, the clone appears as a twin, indistinguishable from the original, moving with the same lethal grace and purpose. The air around the clone pulses with residual Aether energy, creating a faint, almost imperceptible haze that betrays its arcane origin.

The Aether Clone stands as a living extension of the Aetherblade’s will, a mirror image ready to strike fear and confusion into the hearts of their enemies.

powers.name: Aether Leap
powers.effect: [Leap(🏃+2)]; Leave a psionic afterimage [Believe Imgage(👁️)]^👁️.
powers.notes:
Aether Leap is a dynamic ability that allows the Nyax Aetherblade to execute a rapid, long-distance leap, leaving behind a psionic afterimage to disorient and confuse enemies. This ability serves as both a means of quick repositioning and a psychological tactic to mislead opponents.

When Aether Leap is activated, the Aetherblade seems to blur for a split second before vanishing from their original position. A faint, ghostly image of the Aetherblade lingers momentarily, shimmering with psionic energy that flickers like a mirage in the heat. The afterimage holds the gaze of enemies, appearing solid and real until it slowly fades into nothingness. Meanwhile, the Aetherblade reappears in a new location, their sudden materialization accompanied by a subtle, rippling distortion in the air. To onlookers, it seems as if the Aetherblade has momentarily existed in two places at once, creating a sense of confusion and uncertainty on the battlefield.

Aether Leap transforms the Aetherblade into an elusive and unpredictable force, leaving enemies grasping at shadows as they strike from an entirely new position.

powers.name: Aether Step
powers.effect: Shuriken [Atk/Dmg(🏃)/(🏃)]; Double normal range; Teleport to target
powers.notes:
Aether Step is a powerful and dynamic ability that allows the Nyax Aetherblade to instantly teleport to an enemy after striking them with an Aether Shuriken. This ability is ideal for swift repositioning and surprise melee attacks, making the Aetherblade a master of unpredictable and lethal combat.

When Aether Step is activated, the moment the Aether Shuriken hits its target, the Aetherblade feels a surge of energy as they are instantly teleported adjacent to their enemy. The sudden change in position is disorienting to the foe, leaving them vulnerable to the Aetherblade’s follow-up melee strike. The Aetherblade materializes in a blur of motion, their weapon already drawn and poised to deliver a decisive blow before the enemy can react. The range and effectiveness of this teleportation increase with the Aetherblade’s mastery, allowing them to engage targets from greater distances with this seamless combination of ranged and melee attacks.

Aether Step turns the Aetherblade into a deadly and elusive force, able to close the gap between themselves and their target in the blink of an eye, delivering fatal strikes with unparalleled speed.

powers.name: Alpha Link
powers.effect: Max 3 allies; pack can mentally talk and allies may choose to use Alpha's Nish instead of their own.
powers.notes:
Alpha Link is a potent telepathic ability that allows the Were to establish a mental connection with their allies and, with training, even their foes. This telepathic bond enables the Were to communicate thoughts, emotions, and commands instantly, creating a unified consciousness that enhances coordination and understanding among the pack. Through Alpha Link, the Were can lead with unmatched precision, ensuring that their allies move as one, responding to threats and opportunities with perfect synchronicity.

When Alpha Link is activated, the Were’s eyes glow faintly, signaling the establishment of the mental connection. To the Were, the minds of their allies become like beacons of light in the darkness, each one pulsing with its own unique rhythm. Thoughts and emotions flow freely between them, creating a seamless bond that transcends words. For those connected, the world seems to slow down, and a deep sense of unity and purpose takes hold. The Were’s presence in their minds is both comforting and commanding, guiding them with silent precision. For foes who become entangled in this link, the experience is disorienting and terrifying, as the Were’s thoughts breach their defenses, filling their minds with fear and confusion.

At its height, Alpha Link transforms the Were into a true leader, capable of guiding their pack through the most chaotic and dangerous situations with ease. This ability emphasizes the Were's role as the alpha, both mentally and physically dominant, leading their allies to victory through sheer force of will and telepathic command.

powers.effect: Extends caster's hans through a Rift for Atk/Casting/Grabbing or other purposes
powers.notes:
Apparition is a potent ability that allows the Voidcaller to open a rift directly in front of their chest, linked to another chosen location, forming a bridge between the two. Through this rift, the Voidcaller can extend their hands and arms, enabling them to perform actions remotely, including wielding weapons, retrieving objects, or interacting with distant allies. The ability to manipulate reality in this manner makes Apparition a versatile and strategic tool in the Voidcaller’s arsenal.

As the Voidcaller activates Apparition, a swirling rift of dark energy forms before them, pulsating with a deep, resonant hum. The Voidcaller’s hands and arms disappear into the rift, only to reappear through another rift at the chosen location, as though space itself has folded to their will. To those witnessing the effect, it appears as if the Voidcaller is reaching through the very fabric of reality, their limbs emerging from the void to perform precise and calculated actions. The rift’s edges shimmer with a dark light, giving off an eerie, almost hypnotic glow that highlights the Voidcaller’s control over the dimensions.

Apparition turns the Voidcaller into a master of spatial manipulation, allowing them to extend their reach beyond physical limitations and perform actions that defy conventional understanding.

powers.effect: Converts a failed Assassinate Sniper Atk into a hit if Result+100 would have hit
powers.notes:
Assassin's Pool is a critical resource for the Human Starborn Ranger, designed to ensure the success of their most vital Assassinate Feat attacks. By creating a reserve of points specifically for correcting failed attempts, this ability guarantees that the Ranger's lethal strikes land when they are needed most.

When Assassin's Pool is activated, a cold, focused energy envelops the Ranger as they prepare for a kill. The points generated form a mental reservoir, ready to be tapped into if their initial strike falters. In the heat of battle, this reserve allows the Ranger to adjust their aim or apply extra force, converting what could have been a failure into a deadly, accurate hit. The confidence provided by the Assassin's Pool allows the Ranger to strike with unwavering resolve, knowing that they have the means to ensure their success.

With Assassin's Pool, the Starborn Ranger transforms potential failures into decisive victories, making each strike as deadly as it is inevitable.

powers.name: Assassinate
powers.effect: Sniper Shot [Atk/Dmg(👁️+2)/(👁️+3)]; Req: must qualify
powers.notes:
Assassinate is a lethal ability that enables the Human Starborn Ranger to deliver a devastating, first-strike attack with unparalleled precision. Designed for scenarios where surprise and stealth are paramount, this ability ensures that the Ranger can neutralize high-value targets before they even realize they are under threat.

When Assassinate is activated, the world seems to narrow as the Ranger focuses on their target. Time slows, and the Ranger's senses heighten, every detail of the target's movement becoming crystal clear. The Ranger draws their weapon, aiming with deadly intent, and in a single, fluid motion, they strike. The attack is swift, silent, and lethal—two attack rolls and two damage rolls are made, with the Ranger choosing the best outcome from each, ensuring the highest possible damage.

Assassinate turns the Ranger into a silent predator, striking with such precision that their targets are eliminated before they can react.

powers.effect: Bind willing individual to agreement (promise, task, secret). Break agreement: [Binding(✨)]^🫀 or crumble. Max bound per Ver.
powers.notes:
This binds another individual to an agreement with the sorcist. This may be a promise, a task, a quest, a secret, etc. The bound individual must willingly accept the binding or it will not work.  
If at any time the bound individual breaks the agreement, roll Sk^Best(FR,Resist Sorce). If the roll succeeds, the victim will crumble into dust. There is a maximum number of bound individuals per Sorcist. If the number is exceeded, the sorcist must select one of the previously bound to be freed from the binding. The freed individual will only notice if the sorcist fails a Sk^Int.

powers.name: Bio-Mesh Interface
powers.effect: Direct neural control over bioengineered tools (not weapons): turn on/off, give orders.
powers.notes:
Bio-Mesh Interface is an advanced enhancement to the Bio-Tech Armor, allowing the Bio Engineer to seamlessly integrate and control bioengineered tools and weapons. This interface enables the Bio Engineer to connect neural pathways directly to the armor, allowing them to manipulate their bioengineered arsenal without physical contact. This neural connection streamlines operations, allowing the Bio Engineer to issue complex commands and control multiple devices with just a thought.

When the Bio-Mesh Interface is activated, the armor’s hexagonal plates pulse with a synchronized glow, matching the Bio Engineer’s neural activity. A soft hum emanates from the suit as bio-nanites relay signals between the armor and the Bio Engineer's mind, enabling the autonomous handling of tools and weapons. Tentacle-like appendages move with an almost lifelike grace, adjusting equipment and preparing bio-weapons for use. The sensation for the Bio Engineer is akin to having extra limbs, all perfectly attuned to their thoughts, making the armor feel like an extension of their own body.

At its highest level, Bio-Mesh Interface transforms the Bio-Tech Armor into a versatile and formidable extension of the Bio Engineer’s will, allowing for unparalleled efficiency and precision in combat and support roles.

powers.name: Bio-Weapon
powers.effect: Morphs into bio-blade (slashing), bio-spear (piercing), or bio-club (blunt): [Atk/Dmg(💪+5)/(💪+5)].
powers.notes:
Bio-Weapon is a versatile and formidable ability that enhances the Horax Bio Engineer's Bio-Forge Gauntlet, allowing it to morph into one of three specialized bio-weapons: a bio-blade, a bio-spear, or a bio-club. Each weapon form is tailored for a specific type of damage—slashing, piercing, or blunt—providing the Bio Engineer with the flexibility to adapt to a wide range of combat scenarios. The ability to switch between these forms makes the Bio-Weapon an essential tool in the Bio Engineer’s arsenal, turning the gauntlet into a lethal and adaptable extension of their combat prowess.

When the Bio-Weapon is activated, the Bio-Forge Gauntlet undergoes a rapid transformation, the organic material flowing and reshaping itself with a fluid, almost sentient motion. As the gauntlet morphs, a soft, bioluminescent glow emanates from the surface, illuminating the process. The bio-blade extends into a sleek, razor-sharp edge, designed for swift and precise slashing attacks. The bio-spear elongates into a narrow, pointed form, capable of piercing through the toughest armor with deadly accuracy. The bio-club thickens and hardens, its surface becoming knotted and reinforced, ready to deliver bone-crushing blunt force trauma. Each weapon form pulses with a life-like energy, its surface subtly shifting as though it is alive, and the weapon hums faintly as it prepares for combat.

The Bio-Forge Gauntlet becomes a critical asset, its power and lethality increasing with the Bio Engineer's growing mastery.

powers.name: Blade Barrier
powers.effect: Tight radius AoE [Atk/Dmg(✨)/(✨)] on PC's Nish.
powers.notes:
Blade Barrier allows the Nyax Aetherblade to summon a whirling vortex of ethereal blades that surround and protect them. By hurling a light bladed weapon, the Aetherblade channels Aether energy to rapidly duplicate the weapon, forming a deadly barrier of spinning blades that shreds any enemy who ventures too close. This barrier serves as both an offensive and defensive measure, turning the Aetherblade into a mobile fortress of cutting edges.

As the Aetherblade initiates the Blade Barrier, the thrown weapon begins to multiply mid-air, each duplicate shimmering with Aetheric light. The blades encircle the Aetherblade in a tight, spinning formation, creating a vortex of steel and energy that moves with them. The air within the barrier vibrates with the sound of slicing metal, and the surrounding area becomes a deadly zone where the faintest movement triggers a flurry of slashing attacks. To onlookers, the Aetherblade appears as a silhouette encased in a cyclone of lethal blades, their every movement accompanied by a symphony of sharp, metallic whispers.

Blade Barrier transforms the Aetherblade into an impenetrable force of destruction, where any enemy daring enough to approach is met with a storm of slicing death.

Their bite is quick and precise, drawing just enough blood to establish the bond without causing significant harm. As the bond forms, a dark energy flows between the Vamp and their target, sharing the pain or effect, and allowing the Vamp to mitigate the worst of it. This ability is both a protective measure and a tactical tool, allowing the Vamp to control the flow of battle by deciding who bears the brunt of the damage.

As the blade bites into flesh, it not only inflicts severe wounds but also channels a portion of the stolen life force back into the Lifestealer, healing their own injuries. The blood drawn from the wound seems to defy gravity, flowing along the blade's edge and into the Lifestealer’s body, where it visibly rejuvenates them. With each consecutive strike, the blade's glow intensifies, and the Lifestealer’s movements become more fluid and deadly, as if they are feeding off the very life essence of their foe.

Blood Strike embodies the relentless nature of the Vamp Lifestealer, turning every encounter into a battle for survival where the Lifestealer grows stronger as their enemy weakens. The ability to channel their own vitality into their strikes adds a dark twist, allowing the Lifestealer to inflict even greater harm at the cost of their own life force. In the hands of a skilled Vamp, Blood Strike ensures that the longer the fight drags on, the more unstoppable they become.

powers.name: Displace
powers.effect: Vanish and reappear: distance [=(✨)] sq; no intervening movement. If held: [Displace(✨)]^Dif then roll distance.
powers.notes:
*Displace* causes its user to vanish and reappear some distance away. The sorcist may select the direction and distance of the displacement up to a maximum number rolled. The sorcist does not move over the intervening distance, but simply disappears from one spot then appears in the other. If the sorcist is being held (such as MA Hold, Tangler Grenade, etc.) a Sk^Dif must succeed, then a second roll is made for actual distance traveled.   
Displacing through walls or into areas which the sorcist can’t view is dangerous as the sorcist may end up displaced into a solid object. If this occurs refer to *RB, hazards*.

powers.name: Displace Group
powers.effect: Willing targets (including caster) vanish and reappear at chosen square within [=(✨)] sq. Group arrives adjacent; facing unchanged.
powers.notes:
*Displace Group* causes a number of willing targets to vanish and reappear some distance away. Targets must be willing and may including the sorcist. The sorcist may select a destination square within the maximum rolled distance (measured from the sorcist, not any of the targets). The targets will then arrive in adjacent squares “roughly” in the same direction from the center as they started when considered as a whole. Their facing will be unchanged. If the sorcist was also a target, then they will appear in the central target square. Once the destination square is selected, the player can move the figures, but the GM will make any final adjustments as desired.   
	The group does not move over the intervening distances, but simply disappears from one spot then appears in the other. If any member of the group is being held (such as MA Hold, Tangler Grenade, etc.) a separate Sk^Dif must succeed, or that target is not displaced along with the others.  
Displacing through walls or into areas which the sorcist can’t view is challenging, but not dangerous. If the ability ends up displacing targets into a solid objects, they will simply be left behind. This does not apply to the Sorcist themself and if displaced into a solid object, consult the *RB, hazards*. A larger group is more difficult due to the clustering around a central square requiring a larger open space free of obstacles.

powers.name: Dissolution
powers.effect: Store/Retrived a held non-living item in Wraith space
powers.notes:
Dissolution is a powerful ability that allows the Shadowmancer to dissolve an item into a fine, smoky mist, effectively storing it in Wraith space until it is needed again. This ability enables the Voidcaller to securely store valuable or cumbersome items, keeping them safe from harm and ready for instant retrieval. The process of dissolving and retrieving items is a seamless and mystical experience, showcasing the Voidcaller's command over matter and space.

As the Voidcaller channels their ancient wraith energy, the chosen item begins to disintegrate before their eyes, its solid form breaking down into wisps of dark mist. The mist swirls and dances in the air for a moment before slowly fading into nothingness, as if absorbed by the very fabric of reality. The Voidcaller knows that the item is now safely stored in Wraith space, a hidden dimension that only they can access. When the time comes to retrieve the item, the Voidcaller simply reverses the process, summoning the mist back into existence. The mist coalesces into the original object, fully intact and ready for use, as though it had never been altered. The entire process is silent and swift, leaving no trace of the item's disappearance or reappearance.

Dissolution is a testament to the Voidcaller's mastery over the ethereal, allowing them to bend the laws of matter to their will and store objects in a realm beyond the reach of others.

This ability is perfect for delivering cryptic warnings, issuing commands, or conversing in a way that underscores the Shadowmancer's otherworldly nature. The sound of their voice is a chilling blend of multiple tones, creating an unsettling echo that lingers in the air and strikes fear into the hearts of those who hear it.

When the Shadowmancer activates Echoing Whispers, their voice takes on an ethereal quality, as though it is being carried by the winds of the void. The words they speak resonate directly in the ears of their chosen recipients, bypassing walls, doors, and even the vacuum of space. The recipients hear the voice as if it were right next to them, a spectral whisper that is impossible to ignore. The tone is unsettling, a chorus of overlapping voices that seem to come from all directions at once, creating a disorienting and unnerving experience. To anyone else, the words are incomprehensible, lost in the echoes of the void, but to the intended recipients, the message is clear and impossible to forget.

Echoing Whispers allows the Shadowmancer to communicate with an eerie, otherworldly presence, ensuring that their words are heard and remembered by those they choose to speak to, no matter the distance or obstacles in their way.

powers.name: Eclipse
powers.effect: Tight radius total darkness (no visible light, no starlight) to others; Caster sees normally; All of caster's Dark/Void powers gain +15 while inside Eclipse.
powers.notes:
Eclipse is a formidable ability that allows the Voidcaller to summon a globe of impenetrable darkness, engulfing a designated area in shadow. This ability not only disorients and blinds enemies but also amplifies the Voidcaller’s powers, particularly those related to the Void Weaver or Wraith Form, making them an even more formidable force within the darkness. Eclipse turns the battlefield into a domain of shadow, where the Voidcaller reigns supreme.

As Eclipse is summoned, the light within the designated area seems to collapse inward, as if drawn into a singularity. A dense, swirling globe of darkness envelops the area, with the shadows inside shifting and writhing like a living entity. Within this globe, the Voidcaller is the only being capable of seeing through the shadows, their vision slightly dimmed but otherwise unhindered. To those caught within the Eclipse, the world becomes a void of pitch-black nothingness, where even the faintest glimmer of light is snuffed out. The air within the globe feels colder, heavier, as if the darkness itself is pressing down on all within it, amplifying the Voidcaller’s connection to the void.

Eclipse transforms the battlefield into a realm of pure darkness, where the Voidcaller’s powers are heightened, and their enemies are left to stumble blindly through a world they no longer control.

Within this dim environment, the Vamp Lifestealer becomes nearly invisible, moving stealthily among their foes and striking fear into their hearts with every wound inflicted. The oppressive darkness not only enhances the Vamp's stealth but also has a profound psychological impact on enemies within its area of effect.

As the Vamp Lifestealer casts Eclipse Veil, the light around them dims, and shadows stretch and twist unnaturally. The battlefield becomes a realm of fear, where every shadow hides a potential threat. Enemies within the veil find their vision impaired and their nerves frayed, making them more vulnerable to the Vamp’s attacks. Every wound inflicted by the Vamp within the veil forces their enemies to confront their deepest fears, leaving them paralyzed or fleeing in terror. This ability can be cast while in certain Dark Forms, allowing the Vamp to fully capitalize on the veil’s effects while maintaining their monstrous presence.

Eclipse Veil turns the battlefield into the Vamp Lifestealer’s domain, where they can control the flow of combat with fear and darkness. This ability ensures that the Vamp remains a deadly and elusive predator, striking from the shadows and leaving their enemies in a state of constant dread.

Elemental Str Surge is an ability that grants the Vamp Lifestealer a temporary surge of superhuman strength, transforming them into a powerhouse of raw physical force. By activating the nano-elementals within their blood, the Lifestealer’s muscles are rapidly enhanced, allowing them to perform feats of immense power and endurance. This surge of strength enables the Vamp to lift heavy objects, crush opponents, and deliver devastating melee attacks that can overwhelm even the toughest foes. For a brief period, the Lifestealer becomes an unstoppable juggernaut, capable of shattering obstacles and overpowering adversaries with ease.

As Elemental Str Surge takes effect, the Vamp Lifestealer’s physique swells with newfound power, their muscles bulging and their veins pulsing with energy. Their every movement is charged with explosive strength, and their blows land with bone-crushing force. The ground trembles under their feet as they charge into battle, their enemies scattering before them. This surge of power is a sight to behold, as the Lifestealer unleashes their full might, turning the tide of battle with sheer physical dominance.

Elemental Str Surge is a critical tool for the Vamp Lifestealer, providing them with the strength to overcome any obstacle and the power to dominate their enemies in close-quarters combat. This ability ensures that when the Lifestealer needs to rely on brute force, they can do so with devastating effect.

powers.effect: Beetle runs at MR(8) to encapsulate: [Atk(✨)] if hit → [Hibernation(✨)]^🫀 or target in deep hibernation (no bleeding, no death checks, no Defense)
powers.notes:
Encapsulation Beetle is a strategic ability that allows the Horax Bio Engineer to deploy a specialized beetle capable of encapsulating a target in a bio-sack filled with anesthetic stasis fluid. This ability is invaluable for preserving dying allies, capturing high-value targets, or effectively removing enemies from the battlefield. The beetle relentlessly pursues its designated target, ensuring that the encapsulation is successful, whether for protection or incapacitation.

Upon release, the Encapsulation Beetle scuttles rapidly across the ground, its sleek, foot-long form gleaming in the light. The beetle emits a soft clicking noise as it locks onto its target, its movements precise and unwavering. When it reaches the target, the beetle detonates with a wet, organic sound, releasing a translucent bio-sack that envelops the target in an instant. The bio-sack glows faintly, the anesthetic fluid within shimmering as the target is lulled into a deep, hibernation-like state. For allies, this state halts bleeding and other negative effects, preserving their life until they can be revived. For enemies, it serves as a prison, rendering them unconscious and inert, their life signs nearly undetectable.

Encapsulation Beetle is a powerful tool for both preservation and capture, allowing the Bio Engineer to control the battlefield by neutralizing key targets with surgical precision.

powers.name: Encase
powers.effect: Restrain one target: [Encase(✨)]^💪 to hit; immobilized. Each rnd [Break Free(💪)]^✨ or remain encased; caster may move target at MR.
powers.notes:
*Encase* allows the psionicist to create an invisible field of psychic energy, which can surround and restrain an opponent at Sk^Str.   
Encased victims are immobilized. They may take no action other than attempting to break the encasing field using Str^Sk. Those held are very easy to hit giving attackers Atk+1c. Psionicists must maintain concentration in order to keep the victim encased. Concentration action cost is listed below.   
The encased may be moved each round after the first (as part of the concentration) up to the max MR indicated. This can be in any direction within range. However, due to the residual encase energy, falling distance is cut in half.

Enhanced Reflexes empowers the Nyax Aetherblade with superhuman agility by channeling Aether directly into their nervous system, dramatically heightening their reaction times and enabling them to move and perform actions with unparalleled speed.

As the Aetherblade activates Enhanced Reflexes, their body seems to vibrate with a surge of energy, the world around them slowing to a crawl as their senses sharpen to a razor’s edge. The Aether pulses through their veins like liquid lightning, every muscle and nerve firing in perfect synchronization. To the Aetherblade, the battlefield becomes a slow-motion tableau, each movement and attack telegraphed with agonizing clarity. Onlookers would see the Aetherblade as a blur of motion, moving faster than the eye can track, their actions precise and devastatingly swift, as if they are one step ahead of everyone else.

With Enhanced Reflexes, the Nyax Aetherblade becomes a whirlwind of action, executing complex maneuvers in the blink of an eye and leaving their enemies struggling to keep up.

powers.name: Entangling Burst
powers.effect: Tight radius AoE; targets [Atk(✨)] if hit -> trapped [Vine Str(✨*1.1)]^💪 to clear immediate area
powers.notes:
Entangling Burst is a tactical enhancement for the Spore Blaster, transforming it into a powerful tool for crowd control and battlefield domination. When fired, the spore pod releases a burst of entangling spores that rapidly spread upon impact, creating a dense web of bio-organic fibers that ensnare and immobilize enemies. This ability is perfect for halting an enemy’s advance, leaving them vulnerable to further attacks.

Upon activation, Entangling Burst fires a pod that explodes into a cloud of fine, shimmering spores, which then coalesce into thick, fibrous strands. These fibers rapidly grow and intertwine, forming a web-like structure that clings to everything within the area of effect. The fibers emit a faint, greenish glow, making them visible in the dimmest of lights, and their sticky, resilient texture makes it difficult for anyone trapped within to break free. The fibers are resistant to most conventional weapons, requiring powerful slashing or chopping blows to sever them.

Entangling Burst is an essential ability for any Bio Engineer seeking to dominate the flow of combat, turning the environment into a web of ensnarement that leaves enemies at the mercy of the hive.

powers.name: Entangling Shot
powers.effect: If [Atk(👁️+1)] hits -> no Dmg but all in short to medium range (or 1 target) encased in self-repairing vine cage at [Cage Str(💪)]^💪.
powers.notes:
Entangling Shot is a powerful and strategic ability that enhances the Elden Verdant Sentinel’s Living Bow, transforming a simple arrow into a formidable tool of battlefield control. Upon impact, the arrow rapidly sprouts into a massive, self-repairing vine cage that entangles and immobilizes its target, making it nearly impossible for them to escape.

When the Entangling Shot strikes its target, the arrowhead bursts open with a flourish of rapid growth, unleashing thick, sinewy vines that coil tightly around the victim. The vines are a deep green, dotted with small thorns, and they writhe and twist as they form an impenetrable cage. The vines continuously regenerate, healing any damage taken almost instantly, making escape nearly impossible without extraordinary strength. The cage pulses with life, tightening its grip with each passing moment, leaving the trapped target helpless and at the mercy of the Sentinel.

Entangling Shot turns the tide of battle by rendering key enemies helpless, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks or capture.

powers.effect: On wound: explodes for [Dmg(✨)] additional wounds.
powers.notes:
Explosive Shards is a lethal enhancement for the Golemari Geomancer’s Crystal Thrower, transforming each crystal projectile into a ticking time bomb. Upon striking its target, the embedded crystals detonate with a powerful secondary explosion, inflicting additional damage and spreading lethal shards beyond the initial impact. This ability ensures that every successful hit delivers a devastating follow-up, turning a single strike into a multi-stage assault.

As the Geomancer pulls the trigger, the Crystal Thrower emits a sharp, crystalline hum, and the shards are launched with a radiant glow. The initial impact is marked by a dull thud as the crystals pierce their target, followed by an eerie, fleeting silence. Then, with a sharp crack, the crystals erupt in a burst of shrapnel, the sound of breaking glass filling the air as jagged fragments spray outward, striking anything in their path. The explosion is accompanied by a bright flash and a shower of glittering dust, leaving the battlefield littered with the remnants of the detonated shards.

This enhancement transforms the Crystal Thrower into a weapon of unmatched destructive potential, ensuring that every attack carries the risk of catastrophic damage for the enemy.

By sacrificing their own Vitality (Vit), the Lifestealer fills the Red Pool, which can then be drawn upon to turn near misses into successful hits and increase the damage dealt with their melee attacks. As the Lifestealer channels their life force into the Red Pool, a crimson glow emanates from their body, gathering into a swirling vortex of energy that seems to hover just beneath their skin. This energy is palpable, a tangible force that the Lifestealer can feel coursing through their veins, ready to be unleashed at a moment’s notice. When the Lifestealer draws upon the Red Pool in battle, their attacks become more precise and devastating, fueled by the raw power of their own life force. Each strike is accompanied by a surge of crimson energy, as the Lifestealer channels the power of the Red Pool to overcome their enemies. The pool can also be replenished by landing a successful attack with the Vampiric Claws, ensuring that the Lifestealer remains a potent force throughout the battle.

Fill The Red Pool is a testament to the Vamp Lifestealer’s ability to draw strength from their own vitality, allowing them to sustain themselves through sheer willpower and dominate their foes with the power of their own blood.

Fury Blast is as much about control as it is about destruction, using the raw power of the Were's rage to dominate the battlefield.

The ground beneath them trembles as the energy builds, and a low, ominous hum fills the air. This ability is a powerful tool for crowd control, ensuring that the Berserker remains in control of the battlefield, no matter how chaotic the fight becomes.

powers.notes:
Sorcists use this power to become completely insubstantial. A *ghost walking* sorcist grows dim and transparent, actually occupying another dimension. The sorcist may then walk through nearly anything (walls, doors, other living things, etc.)  
*Ghost walkers* are only affected by (and can only be affected by) others in the *ghost* dimension. Vision is the only sense that “can” (see Versions) occur between the dimensions, but at best things in the other dimension look faint and hazy. Objects carried by the sorcist also join the Sorcist in the ghost dimension, and remain that way until the sorcist returns to this dimension. If reappear in a solid object, the Sorcist will be slid to the closest open square as per GM.

*Ghost walkers* must remain within a Teachered area as rolled. The tether is the square upon which Ghost Walk was initially cast. Going beyond this tether limit instantly causes the Sorcist to become solid again and the ability ends. Each round the Sorcits may walk in the Ghost dimension using their normal MR (until Ver5). Also there is NO known way to communicate between the dimensions.

These gravity-altering fields make it nearly impossible for foes to maneuver, trapping them and leaving them vulnerable to the Geomancer’s attacks. The affected area is marked by a conspicuous glyph, warning those who are perceptive enough to recognize the danger.

When Gravitational Wells is cast, the ground within the targeted area darkens, and a large, glowing glyph appears at its center, pulsating with an eerie, gravitational force. The air within the zone feels heavy, as if the very atmosphere is pressing down on everything within. Enemies caught in the field struggle against the overwhelming pull, their movements slowed to a crawl, while those who fail to escape are dragged to the ground, pinned by the crushing weight of intensified gravity. The visual distortion within the zone, as if the air itself is bending, serves as a constant reminder of the unseen force at work, making the area a deadly trap for any who dare to enter.

With Growth Hormone, the Horax Bio Engineer can drastically alter the dynamics of a battle, empowering their allies to crush opposition with overwhelming might. The images created must be described to the GM, who then determines Dif. If the change is easy to believe or expected, like having an item appear where it should be even if it isn’t there,  then the Adj may reduce the Dif to near zero. If the image is of a familiar person walking into the room, then the Dif will be a little higher due to the complexity of the hallucination. If the hallucination is an unexpected and complex, entirely fake scene like a group in a bar bar suddenly being on a space ship as it crashes, then the Dif may be extremely high.

The Hallucination will persist as long as the Psionicist concentrates at the Act cost below. Targets may attempt to break the hallucination every round unless the GM determines that there is no reason (such as a simple, easy to believe hallucination or a really great roll by the player).

powers.notes:
Herbal Tincture is a versatile and restorative ability of the Elden Verdant Sentinel, enabling them to harness the healing properties of plants to create powerful tinctures. These tinctures, carefully crafted by the Sentinel using summoned or found flora, provide a range of benefits that can be stored for future use. Each tincture is a small, leaf-wrapped or gourd-contained remedy that, when consumed, delivers a potent effect chosen by the imbiber at the time of drinking.

The process of creating a tincture is an art in itself. The resulting tincture glows faintly with a natural green light, the aroma of fresh-cut leaves wafting from its container. When consumed, the tincture spreads warmth through the body, either knitting wounds, neutralizing poisons, or purging diseases, depending on the need of the moment.

Herbal Tincture exemplifies the Sentinel’s ability to prepare for any eventuality, ensuring that nature’s remedies are always at hand to sustain their allies through the trials of battle.

powers.name: Hide in Shadows
powers.effect: MR(3). Take 20 Wnds immediately and each round (on Nish) if not in shadows or when crossing between shadows.
powers.notes:
Hide in Shadows is a powerful and risky ability that allows the Shadowmancer to detach from their physical form, becoming a pure shadow wraith capable of moving undetected and nearly impervious to damage. In this form, the Shadowmancer is free to move through interconnected shadows, slipping through the smallest of cracks and evading detection with ease. However, the Shadowmancer must remain in shadows to maintain this form, as exposure to light or the loss of shadows forces them to return to their abandoned armor, suffering severe wounds in the process.

As the Shadowmancer invokes Hide in Shadows, their physical body seems to melt away, leaving behind a dark, shapeless form that merges seamlessly with the surrounding shadows. In this state, the Shadowmancer becomes a living shadow, indistinguishable from the darkness around them. They move with a fluid grace, slipping through cracks and crevices that would be impossible for a physical being to traverse. The shadow form is silent and nearly invisible, a formless wraith that passes through the world without leaving a trace. However, this form is fragile, and the Shadowmancer knows that they must avoid light and remain within the safety of the shadows, for if the shadows are banished, they will be forced to return to their physical form, vulnerable and wounded.

Hide in Shadows transforms the Shadowmancer into a true creature of the night, a being of pure darkness that can move unseen and untouched, but at the risk of great harm if they are exposed to the light.

powers.name: Hive Link Swarm
powers.effect: Swarm 10r; unsealed allies in AoE share all active thoughts and vision.
powers.notes:
Hive Link Swarm is a powerful ability utilized by the Horax Bio Engineer to enhance battlefield coordination and communication among allies. By constructing and releasing a cloud of flying mites, the Bio Engineer establishes a telepathic connection within the swarm’s area of effect, allowing all unsealed allies to share their active thoughts seamlessly. This telepathic link ensures that the hive operates with unmatched precision, enabling rapid strategic planning, instant information sharing, and perfectly synchronized movements.

When Hive Link Swarm is activated, the air around the Bio Engineer buzzes with the faint sound of tiny wings as the swarm of bio-mites takes flight. The mites form a shimmering cloud that pulses with a soft, greenish light, moving in tandem with the Bio Engineer as they traverse the battlefield. Allies within the swarm’s radius feel a sudden clarity of thought as their minds are linked, allowing them to communicate wordlessly and share their sensory experiences. The sensation is both comforting and empowering, as each ally becomes acutely aware of their surroundings and the thoughts of their comrades. As the swarm expands, the shared information grows richer, including not only thoughts but also smells, touches, and even visual data, creating a deeply integrated hive mind.

Hive Link Swarm transforms the Bio Engineer and their allies into a perfectly synchronized unit, capable of overwhelming any adversary with their unity and precision.

powers.name: Holo-Cloak
powers.effect: Invisible (visible light only); silenced. [Stealth(🏃+1)]^👁️ only if opponent actively scanning or has hidden/special vision.
powers.notes:
The Holo-Cloak is a personal cloaking device that renders the Starborn Ranger invisible to most sensors and visual detection. This high-tech device bends light and electronic signals around the Ranger, creating the illusion of empty space where they stand, making it a powerful tool for stealth and infiltration missions.

When the Holo-Cloak is activated, a shimmering field of energy envelops the Ranger, distorting the light and making them appear to dissolve into thin air. As the Ranger moves, the cloak adjusts, maintaining their invisibility and silencing any sounds they make. The faint distortion left behind is nearly impossible to detect unless someone is actively searching for it, allowing the Ranger to move undetected through even the most heavily guarded areas.

With the Holo-Cloak, the Ranger becomes a shadow, unseen and unheard, capable of infiltrating enemy territory and completing their mission with perfect stealth.

powers.notes:
Holo-Clone is a sophisticated ability that enhances the Human Starborn Ranger's Spectre Armor, enabling them to create lifelike holographic duplicates of themselves. These holo-clones are indistinguishable from the Ranger in appearance and behavior, making them a powerful tool for misdirection and confusion on the battlefield.

When activated, the Spectre Armor shimmers briefly before multiple holographic replicas of the Ranger appear around them. These clones move in perfect synchronization with the Ranger, their every step and gesture mirroring the original with uncanny accuracy. To the enemy, it’s impossible to discern which figure is real as the holo-clones dart and weave, creating a chaotic dance of light and motion that confounds even the sharpest eyes.

With Holo-Clone, the Ranger turns deception into a deadly art, leaving their enemies disoriented and vulnerable as they strike from the shadows.

powers.effect: 3×3 area [Atk/Dmg(✨)/(✨)] for Dur rnds; only harms flammable targets.
powers.notes:
Incendiary Barrage is a devastating ability that allows the CyberDrake Inferno Vanguard to unleash a relentless salvo of fiery projectiles over a wide area, engulfing multiple enemies in flames. When activated, the Vanguard rapidly fires a series of incendiary rounds that cover the designated area, igniting anything flammable in their path. This ability is particularly lethal to those made of or carrying flammable materials, including most living creatures, organic matter, and unprotected objects.

Visually, the Incendiary Barrage is a spectacle of raw firepower. The Vanguard launches a barrage of fiery projectiles that streak through the air like shooting stars, leaving glowing trails in their wake. Upon impact, each projectile explodes in a burst of flame, sending out fiery tendrils that latch onto anything flammable. The targeted area is quickly engulfed in an inferno, with flames spreading rapidly and consuming everything within reach. The battlefield becomes a sea of fire, with the Vanguard at the center of the destruction.

Incendiary Barrage epitomizes raw, uncontained firepower, transforming the Vanguard into a relentless force of fiery destruction that incinerates everything in its path.

powers.name: Increased Stamina
powers.effect: Target's: Moxie Atr and Skills gain *1.5; Abosbs 5 Wnds per hit
powers.notes:
Increased Stamina is an advanced bioengineering ability that allows the Horax Bio Engineer to modify an ally's metabolic processes, greatly enhancing their stamina and endurance. This ability optimizes the body's energy production and utilization, ensuring that the ally can sustain peak performance for extended periods without succumbing to fatigue, making them a more formidable presence in prolonged engagements.

When Increased Stamina is activated, the target experiences a surge of vitality coursing through their body. Their breathing steadies, and their heart rate becomes more efficient, as if their entire system is being fine-tuned for endurance. A subtle, invigorating warmth spreads from their core, revitalizing their muscles and clearing their mind of exhaustion. The target feels lighter, more agile, and filled with an unshakable resolve to press on. The sensation is akin to catching a second wind, where every step feels easier and every movement more controlled, allowing them to fight longer and harder without wearing down.

Increased Stamina is an essential tool for the Horax Bio Engineer, ensuring that the hive's warriors can outlast their enemies and maintain their dominance on the battlefield. By enhancing the ally’s ability to endure, the Bio Engineer ensures that the hive remains a resilient and unstoppable force.

powers.notes:
Inferno Blow is a devastating ability that enhances the CyberDrake Inferno Vanguard's Inferno Blade, allowing it to unleash a searing heatwave with every strike. Upon activation, this ability channels the flames of the blade into a powerful blow, causing an intense heatwave to radiate outward from the point of impact. Nearby enemies with defenses and armor ratings equal to or lesser than the initial target are scorched by this overwhelming heat, suffering additional damage. This makes the Inferno Blade not just a weapon of singular focus but a tool for area-wide destruction, spreading its fiery wrath across the battlefield.

When Inferno Blow is unleashed, the heatwave is visually stunning and terrifying. Flames erupt from the point of impact, sending shockwaves of heat in all directions. Enemies caught within range are momentarily engulfed in flames, their armor glowing red-hot as the heatwave sears through their defenses. This intense display of power transforms the battlefield into a smoldering inferno, leaving a trail of scorched earth and shattered foes in its wake.

With each swing, Inferno Blow turns the battlefield into a blazing crucible, where only the strongest can hope to survive.

powers.notes:
Insect Swarm is a fearsome ability that enhances the Elden Verdant Sentinel’s Botanic Grenades, unleashing a deadly cloud of poisonous, biting insects upon the battlefield. These insects are relentless in their attack, capable of penetrating all but the most airtight armor, and they inflict severe damage on any living being caught within their swarm.

When the Insect Swarm is unleashed, the air around the battlefield becomes thick with the buzzing, whirring sound of countless tiny wings. The insects pour forth from the Botanic Grenade in a dark, seething cloud, moving as one with a terrifying, predatory instinct. The swarm engulfs its target, with the insects biting and stinging relentlessly, injecting venom that causes excruciating pain and rapid deterioration. The swarm moves like a living, breathing entity, flowing across the battlefield and leaving devastation in its wake as it seeks out new victims to consume.

Insect Swarm turns the battlefield into a living nightmare, ensuring that the Sentinel’s enemies are overwhelmed by the relentless onslaught of nature’s fury.

powers.name: Life Drain
powers.effect: Tight radius AoE: [Life Drain(✨)]^✨ → 5 Wnd/rnd cummulative. Per target wounded per round, caster regenerates 1 1st Deg wound.
powers.notes:
Life Drain is a potent and terrifying ability that allows the Vamp Lifestealer to siphon the life force from all living beings within its area of effect. Upon activation, the Vamp radiates a dark, ethereal mist that subtly draws out the vitality of nearby creatures, friend and foe alike. This draining aura inflicts wounds each round, steadily weakening those within its radius. As their life force ebbs away, victims experience growing fatigue and injury, leaving them more vulnerable to the Vamp’s further assaults.

The dark mist that envelops the battlefield when Life Drain is activated is almost imperceptible at first, but its effects are quickly felt by those within its reach. The Vamp Lifestealer stands at the center of this malevolent aura, drawing strength from the life energy of those around them. Each round, the wounds inflicted by Life Drain sap the vitality of its victims, weakening them while simultaneously healing the Vamp. For every five wounds caused by Life Drain, the Vamp regenerates one of their own wounds, making them increasingly difficult to defeat as the battle wears on.

Life Drain exemplifies the Vamp Lifestealer’s predatory nature, allowing them to feed on the life force of their enemies while sustaining themselves in prolonged battles. This ability ensures that the Vamp remains a formidable opponent, capable of turning the tide of battle through sheer endurance and the relentless draining of their enemies’ vitality.

powers.name: Lupine Agility
powers.effect: Substitute for Parkour, Acrobatics, Jump, Climb, or Balance; [Agility(🏃+2)].
powers.notes:
Lupine Agility grants the Were unparalleled acrobatic prowess, enhancing their reflexes, balance, and coordination to superhuman levels. This ability allows the Were to navigate their environment with effortless grace, whether leaping across rooftops, scaling sheer walls, or dodging enemy attacks with lightning-fast movements. Lupine Agility makes the Were a master of movement, able to traverse any terrain with fluid precision.

When Lupine Agility is activated, the Were moves with an elegance that is almost otherworldly. Their body becomes a blur as they dash through obstacles, each motion perfectly controlled and balanced. To onlookers, the Were seems to defy gravity, their movements a seamless dance of agility and power. The air swirls around them as they leap from one point to another, their landings as soft and silent as a shadow. The Were's heightened senses pick up every detail of their surroundings, allowing them to react with uncanny speed to any threat or opportunity.

In the midst of battle, Lupine Agility turns the Were into a swift and elusive predator, their movements too fast and too fluid to be easily tracked or targeted. This ability not only enhances their combat effectiveness but also reinforces their role as a deadly and unpredictable force, capable of striking from any angle and evading danger with ease.

powers.name: Lycanthropy
powers.effect: Transform into: Dire Wolf: MR(12), [Jumps(🏃+2)], bite [Atk/Dmg(💪)/(💪+1)]; if hit -> Bite can Latch for [Dmg(💪)] each round.
powers.notes:
Lycanthropy is the signature ability of the Were, allowing them to transform into various forms, including the Dire Wolf, Fenrir Wolf, Werewolf, or even a pack of wolves. This shape-shifting power grants the Were unparalleled versatility, enabling them to adapt to any situation or threat with remarkable ease. Each form offers unique advantages, making Lycanthropy an essential tool for the Were in both combat and survival.

The transformation triggered by Lycanthropy is a mesmerizing and fearsome spectacle. The Were's body twists and reshapes in an instant, muscles and bones contorting to fit the chosen form. Their skin ripples and fur sprouts in waves, while their eyes glow with a fierce, predatory light. The air is filled with the sound of cracking bones and tearing flesh, but the process is seamless and fluid, almost as if the Were is shedding one skin for another. To those witnessing the transformation, it is both a display of raw power and a reminder of the Were's connection to the primal forces of nature.

At its peak, Lycanthropy makes the Were an unstoppable force, able to shift between forms to best suit the needs of the moment. Whether tearing through enemies as a fearsome wolf or overwhelming foes with the coordinated attack of a pack, the Were's ability to transform ensures they remain a dominant predator, feared and respected by all.

powers.name: Magnetic Pulse
powers.effect: Set an anchor mark, all in Tight radius AoE ferrous weapons/shields: [Pulled(💪)]^💪 or fly to mark. Mostly ferrous armor: [Pull Prone(💪)]^💪 or fall prone toward Mark.
powers.notes:
Magnetic Pulse is a versatile ability that enables the Golemari Geomancer to manipulate magnetic fields, disarming enemies of ferrous weapons and destabilizing those wearing ferrous armor. By harnessing the power of magnetism, the Geomancer can create both offensive and defensive opportunities, disrupting enemy formations and leaving them vulnerable to attack.

Upon activation, the air around the Geomancer crackles with energy, and a focused pulse of magnetic force radiates out from the chosen point of impact. Ferrous weapons and armor within the affected area begin to vibrate violently, emitting a high-pitched whine as they are wrenched from their owners’ grasp or pulled forcefully toward the designated Mark. The metallic objects seem to take on a life of their own, twisting and contorting as they are dragged across the battlefield. Those wearing heavy armor find themselves pulled off balance, crashing to the ground as the magnetic force overpowers their strength. The Mark itself glows faintly, a beacon of concentrated magnetic energy that draws metal toward it with irresistible force.

Magnetic Pulse turns the enemy's own equipment into a liability, using the power of magnetism to disrupt and control the battlefield in the Golemari Geomancer’s favor.

powers.notes:
Magnetic Repulsor is a defensive ability that allows the Golemari Geomancer to generate a powerful magnetic field, repelling incoming ferrous projectiles and reducing the damage from ferrous melee weapons. This protective aura not only deflects attacks but can also reflect projectiles back at the attacker, turning their own weapons against them. The Magnetic Repulsor is a crucial tool for the Geomancer, providing both defense and counterattack capabilities against metal-based threats.

When Magnetic Repulsor is activated, a shimmering, translucent field of energy envelops the Geomancer, its surface crackling with magnetic sparks. The air around the Geomancer hums with power, and any ferrous projectile that comes within range is suddenly deflected with a sharp, metallic clang, often hurtling back toward the attacker with deadly precision. The repulsor field glows faintly, its surface rippling as it absorbs and disperses the force of incoming attacks. As ferrous melee weapons strike the Geomancer, they seem to lose their momentum, the impact softened as the magnetic field dissipates their energy.

Magnetic Repulsor allows the Golemari Geomancer to turn the enemy’s strength against them, using the power of magnetism to defend and retaliate with deadly efficiency.

powers.notes:
Mantis Targeter is a specialized ability of the Horax Bio Engineer, enabling them to deploy a praying mantis-like creature that enhances the accuracy of missile weapons. The mantis forms a strong psionic link with its host’s mind, fine-tuning the weapon’s aim and improving the host’s agility during the aiming process. This ability is invaluable for increasing the effectiveness of ranged attacks, ensuring that each shot is more precise and deadly.

When Mantis Targeter is activated, the mantis creature, with its sleek, segmented body and translucent wings, flies swiftly to the designated missile weapon. Upon landing, it attaches itself to the weapon, its legs gripping the surface with a delicate yet unyielding hold. The mantis’s wings flutter as it synchronizes with the host’s mind, its compound eyes glowing faintly as it taps into the host’s targeting thoughts. The weapon feels almost alive in the host’s hands, responding with enhanced precision as the mantis subtly adjusts its aim. With each shot, the mantis’s influence is felt, guiding the projectile with unnerving accuracy, whether in daylight or darkness.

Mantis Targeter is a powerful enhancement, turning even the most ordinary missile weapon into a precision tool of destruction, perfectly aligned with the host’s intentions.

Mesmerise is a powerful Shadow Magic ability that allows the Vamp Lifestealer to exert control over a target through dark hypnotic influence. When activated, the Vamp's eyes emit a supernatural glow that draws the victim's gaze into a shadowy abyss, compelling them to listen and obey. This ability induces a trance-like state in the target, rendering them highly susceptible to the Vamp's commands. The target becomes a puppet to the Vamp’s will, unable to resist the overwhelming mental force.

As the Vamp Lifestealer locks eyes with their target, a deep, shadowy glow emanates from their gaze, pulling the victim into a hypnotic trance. The victim’s eyes glaze over as they fall under the Vamp’s spell, their mind bending to the Vamp’s will. The Vamp can then issue commands, ranging from simple orders to complex instructions, depending on the level of the ability. The victim, unable to resist, carries out these commands with unquestioning obedience, becoming an unwitting tool in the Vamp’s hands. Whether compelling the target to reveal secrets, hold still for an attack, or even protect the Vamp, Mesmerise is a versatile and dangerous tool for manipulation and control.

Mesmerise showcases the Vamp Lifestealer’s mastery over the minds of others, allowing them to turn enemies into allies or puppets with a single, hypnotic gaze. This ability ensures that the Vamp can manipulate the battlefield to their advantage, using their enemies’ own minds against them.

powers.name: Molten Core
powers.effect: On hit, thermite adheres; each round roll [Dmg(✨)]
powers.notes:
Molten Core is an advanced enhancement for the CyberDrake Inferno Vanguard’s Thermite Grenades, designed to significantly increase the destructive power of each explosive. When activated, this ability channels additional energy into the thermite, causing it to adhere to the target on impact. This results in an exceptionally intense burn that not only causes an initial explosion but also continues to inflict damage over time. The thermite’s relentless burn can melt through armor, flesh, and fortifications, making it an extremely effective tool for sustained damage on the battlefield.

Visually, when Molten Core is activated, the thermite within the grenade glows with a bright, molten orange hue, radiating intense heat. Upon detonation, the thermite splashes onto the target, clinging to surfaces and burning with a fierce, unyielding flame. The effect is a terrifying spectacle, with the target engulfed in flames that continue to eat away at them, reducing metal and stone to molten slag, while the intense heat distorts the air around it. This lingering burn serves as a constant threat, ensuring that the target remains vulnerable as the damage persists, making each Molten Core-enhanced grenade a long-lasting weapon of devastation.

As the Vanguard’s mastery of Molten Core advances, each grenade becomes a blazing engine of unstoppable destruction, melting everything in its path.

Using telekinesis, psionicists may move an object with max weight as listed below. The object may be moved up to a number of feet each round equal to a *skill* check, as long as the object is not being held or restrained in any way.  
This is especially useful for moving dangerous items such as bombs, red-hot metal, etc. This ability will not work on anything with a mind (biological or otherwise).

The listed Duration is how long the strength can be maintained, so the target could be lifted, held etc. for up to the Dur. The object cannot be moved more than a few feet and a new object may not be chosen during the Dur.

powers.name: Nano-Scope
powers.effect: Maps starlight onto scope HUD; provides extended range and [Detect Hidden(👁️+2)] tagets and threats
powers.notes:
The Nano-Scope is a cutting-edge enhancement for the Starborn Ranger’s weapon, transforming a standard scope into a sophisticated tool that enhances vision and detection capabilities. This nano-tech marvel allows the Ranger to spot hidden threats, identify weaknesses, and track targets at extreme distances with precision.

When the Nano-Scope is activated, nanobots quickly assemble or enhance the existing scope, projecting a translucent HUD that overlays crucial data onto the Ranger’s view. Heat signatures, movement patterns, and structural weaknesses are highlighted in vivid detail, allowing the Ranger to line up the perfect shot. The scope’s range and damage potential are significantly enhanced, turning the Ranger into an unparalleled scout and sniper, capable of seeing through obstacles and pinpointing enemy positions with deadly accuracy.

With the Nano-Scope, the Ranger gains the ability to see beyond the visible, turning every shot into a calculated and lethal strike.

powers.name: Nature's Wrath
powers.effect: 8' vine-arm, MR(0), Atk Rng 3: [Atk/Dmg(✨-1)/(✨+1)], [Dod/AR(✨-1)/(✨-1)] [Vit(✨-1)]. GTH then [Athletics(💪)]^💪 to hold; if held, slam [Dmg(✨)]^AR.
powers.notes:
Nature's Wrath is a formidable ability that allows the Elden Verdant Sentinel to summon a massive, tentacle-like vine-arm covered in deadly thorns. This powerful force of nature bursts forth from the ground, targeting a single enemy with devastating blows, embodying the raw, untamed power of nature.

When Nature's Wrath is unleashed, the earth splits open with a violent crack, and from the depths emerges a colossal vine-arm, its surface bristling with razor-sharp thorns. The vine writhes with a life of its own, its movements purposeful and menacing as it seeks out its designated target. The air is filled with the sound of creaking wood and the hiss of thorny tendrils as the vine lashes out, delivering crushing blows that send shockwaves through the ground. The vine's strikes are relentless, each impact reverberating with the raw power of nature itself, leaving the target battered and broken under its unyielding assault.

Nature's Wrath turns the tide of battle by transforming nature into a weapon of immense destructive potential, ensuring that no enemy can escape its relentless grasp.

powers.name: Necro Skin
powers.effect: If caster is attacked with body weapon (touched): [Necrosis(✨)]^✨ → [1d4] Wnds/rnd, cummulative, so if a 2nd Atk and  [Necrosis(✨)]^✨then [2d4], etc.
powers.notes:
Necro Skin is a terrifying ability that allows the Vamp Lifestealer to infuse their flesh with potent necrotic energy, turning their skin into a deadly defensive weapon. Any physical contact with the Vamp's skin initiates a sinister transfer of this energy, forcing the target to save or contract a severe necrotic curse. The infection rapidly deteriorates the target's flesh, causing excruciating pain and ongoing damage each round for a set duration. This ability not only enhances the Vamp’s defensive capabilities but also instills fear in their enemies, knowing that even a touch can lead to a slow, agonizing demise.

As Necro Skin takes effect, the Vamp Lifestealer’s skin darkens and takes on an eerie, mottled appearance, as if imbued with death itself. Any foe who dares to strike the Vamp with bare flesh or light armor feels the necrotic energy seeping into their body, causing immediate and severe pain. The necrosis spreads quickly, weakening the victim as their flesh deteriorates and their vitality drains away. This curse lingers, causing ongoing damage and potentially incapacitating the victim over time. Necro Skin turns the Vamp Lifestealer into a walking plague, their very touch a death sentence for those foolish enough to engage them in close combat.

Necro Skin underscores the Vamp Lifestealer’s lethal nature, turning their body into a weapon that inflicts pain and suffering on any who dare to strike them. This ability ensures that the Vamp remains a formidable force on the battlefield, capable of turning the tide of combat with a single touch.

powers.name: Necrosis
powers.effect: Each wounding hit with the same weapon vs the same taget causes +5 Wnds cummulative unless [Necrosis(✨+2)]^🫀
powers.notes:
Necrosis is a terrifying ability that transforms the Vamp Lifestealer's Red Whip into a weapon of relentless life drain, a manifestation of their vampiric power. When activated, Necrosis inflicts a debilitating condition upon its victims, causing their vitality to decay steadily over time. Each strike with the Red Whip becomes more than just a physical attack—it marks the beginning of a slow, inevitable decline for the target, as their life force is sapped away with every passing moment. This condition is nearly impossible to cure, making it a formidable tool in the Lifestealer’s arsenal.

Visually, Necrosis manifests as a dark, creeping energy that spreads from the point of contact, suffusing the target’s body with a sickly, pulsating glow. The victim’s flesh may blacken and wither where the whip strikes, as if being consumed by an invisible, corrosive force. Each subsequent strike intensifies this effect, as the necrotic energy compounds, accelerating the rate of decay. The target's life force seems to be drawn out of them, leaving them increasingly frail and vulnerable, their movements becoming sluggish as the necrosis spreads.

Necrosis exemplifies the Vamp Lifestealer’s ability to dominate the battlefield through attrition, turning every strike into a lingering death sentence. As the necrotic energy takes hold, the victim's strength wanes, their life slipping away bit by bit, until there is nothing left but a hollow shell, drained of all vitality.

powers.name: Necrotic Fortitude
powers.effect: Regenerate 1 2nd Deg wound each round. Immune to poison, disease, vacuum; cannot bleed.
powers.notes:
Necrotic Fortitude is an ability that reflects the Shadowmancer's undead-like nature, granting them a host of resistances and immunities that set them apart from living beings. This ability renders the wraith impervious to poison, disease, extreme temperatures, and even the vacuum of space. The Shadowmancer no longer requires food, water, or air to survive, allowing them to exist indefinitely without sustenance. In addition, Necrotic Fortitude prevents the Shadowmancer from bleeding and ensures that once they are dead, they can only be revived through arcane means, not by typical or advanced scientific methods.

When Necrotic Fortitude is active, the Shadowmancer exudes an aura of deathly calm, their body seemingly untouched by the elements or the passage of time. Their skin takes on a pallor that hints at their undead nature, and their movements are slow and deliberate, as though they are conserving their energy for the moment when it is needed most. To those around them, the Shadowmancer appears as a being that is no longer tethered to the mortal plane, a wraith that has transcended the need for physical sustenance and is impervious to the dangers that would kill a living being. The Shadowmancer's wounds, if they occur, do not bleed, and their lifeless form does not slump or fall, instead remaining eerily still as if they are simply waiting for the right moment to strike again.

Necrotic Fortitude underscores the Shadowmancer's detachment from the mortal world, granting them a resilience that is both terrifying and awe-inspiring, as they endure where others would fall.

powers.name: Necrovision
powers.effect: Perceive (see) life/death (in monochrome) at [Necrovision(✨)]. Vs sealed or inanimate is Dis.
powers.notes:
Necrovision is a supernatural ability that grants the Shadowmancer the power to perceive the ebb and flow of life and death in all forms. This ability allows the Shadowmancer to see the vital essence of living beings, detecting even the faintest traces of life, down to microbes and viruses. Through Necrovision, the world appears in varying shades of vitality, with vibrant life forms glowing brightly and inanimate objects appearing dim and lifeless. This ability grants the wraith an unparalleled understanding of the balance between life and death, enabling them to navigate and interact with their environment with eerie precision.

When the Shadowmancer activates Necrovision, their eyes glow with an unnatural light, as though they are peering into another plane of existence. The world around them shifts into monochrome, with shades of grey representing the various levels of life force present in the environment. Living beings appear as bright, glowing figures, their life force pulsing with every heartbeat. Inanimate objects, on the other hand, appear as dim, shadowy outlines, barely visible against the backdrop of the living world. The Shadowmancer can see through most forms of concealment, detecting life even when it is hidden behind walls or other obstacles. However, sealed barriers, such as glass or force fields, render Necrovision ineffective, leaving the Shadowmancer blind to the life beyond them.

Necrovision grants the Shadowmancer the ability to see the world in a way that is both eerie and enlightening, allowing them to detect life in all its forms and navigate the battlefield with a precision that is unmatched by the living.

powers.name: Neurotoxin Stun
powers.effect: On hit: [Sk(✨)]^🫀 or paralized
powers.notes:
Neurotoxin Stun is a potent ability of the Elden Verdant Sentinel’s Bio-Vine Whip, designed to incapacitate foes with a single strike. When activated, the Bio-Vine Whip releases a specialized neurotoxin upon contact, targeting the nervous system of the victim. This toxin is expertly engineered to induce a temporary paralysis, stunning the target and rendering them immobile for the duration of the effect.

As the neurotoxin courses through the target’s body, it spreads like wildfire, quickly paralyzing their muscles and leaving them helpless. The effects are almost immediate, with the target’s limbs seizing up and their body going rigid as the poison takes hold. The whip itself seems to pulse with a faint green glow as the toxin is delivered, a visual cue to the power and precision of the Sentinel’s strike. The target’s eyes widen in panic as they realize they are completely at the mercy of the Sentinel’s command, unable to move or resist.

With Neurotoxin Stun, the Sentinel can turn the tide of conflict with a well-timed strike, showcasing their mastery over both nature and combat.

powers.name: PA-TING!
powers.effect: On successful Dodge🏃; make 1 immediate counter-Atk⚔️ at Disadvantage

powers.name: Pack Tactics
powers.effect: For all allies, Each ally that attacks the same target Wnds + (# of Allies attacking that target)*3; requires at least 2 allies per target
powers.notes:
Pack Tactics is a strategic ability that allows the Were Bloodfang Berserker to coordinate attacks and defenses with their allies, amplifying their effectiveness on the battlefield. This ability is a testament to the power of teamwork, as the Berserker and their allies work in perfect unison to overwhelm their enemies. Pack Tactics is more than just a coordination of effort—it is a merging of minds and wills, creating a cohesive unit that moves and strikes as one.

When Pack Tactics is activated, a faint, glowing aura connects the Berserker and their allies, symbolizing their shared purpose and unity. This aura pulses with a rhythmic energy, synchronizing their movements and attacks. To those within the connection, there is a heightened sense of awareness and anticipation, as if they can feel each other's intentions before they are even fully formed. The Berserker's commands are understood instinctively, and their allies respond with perfect precision. As they move in tandem, their combined strength and ferocity become a formidable force, striking their enemies with a coordinated onslaught that is impossible to withstand.

At its peak, Pack Tactics turns the Berserker and their allies into an unstoppable pack, where each member's strengths are magnified through unity and cooperation. This ability ensures that the Berserker's pack is more than just a group of individuals—it is a single, powerful entity capable of dominating the battlefield through sheer, collective might.

powers.name: Parry Mastery
powers.effect: Using melee weapon, can [Blk/AR(💪+2.5)/(🧥)]
powers.notes:
Parry Mastery exemplifies the Nyax Aetherblade's unparalleled skill in defense, allowing them to deflect or parry incoming attacks with supernatural precision. This mastery turns the Aetherblade’s weapon into an almost impenetrable shield, capable of intercepting blows that would be impossible for ordinary warriors to block, showcasing their expertise in both swordsmanship and their deep connection to the Aether.

When the Aetherblade engages Parry Mastery, their blade moves with lightning speed, effortlessly deflecting incoming strikes. Each parry is accompanied by a sharp, resonant clash of steel, the blade almost seeming to anticipate the attack before it arrives. The Aetherblade’s movements are fluid, their sword tracing arcs of glowing energy as it meets and redirects every threat. To onlookers, the Aetherblade appears untouchable, a master of defense whose every motion is a seamless blend of instinct and practiced skill, turning their blade into an extension of their will.

Parry Mastery transforms the Aetherblade into a nearly invincible force, where even the most ferocious of assaults are met with calm, controlled deflection, leaving the Aetherblade unscathed and ready to counter.
